recorded: The case passed 50 runs against the unchanged original with Node.js 26.12.1, run as node src/index.ts, the same file npm start runs with type stripping, without installing anything, since the template imports only node:crypto. The template takes no input and calls no model. Its IV is random, so the encrypted message is compared by shape: a 16-byte IV that is not all zeros and the single block that Hello, World! pads to, both in lowercase hex. The decrypted line is compared exactly.

cases.name: encrypts Hello, World! with the passphrase under a fresh IV, prints iv:ciphertext in hex, and decrypts it back
